title: Ensure 'Configure SMB v1 server' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\Configure SMB v1 server to 'Disabled'
reason: SMBv1 is a legacy protocol with severe security vulnerabilities. Microsoft strongly encourages that SMBv1 be disabled.

title: Ensure 'Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (always)' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (always) to 'Enabled'
reason: Session hijacking uses tools that allow attackers who have access to the same network as the client or server to interrupt, end, or steal a session in progress. SMB signing mitigates this risk.
